dataType.description: The Type that should be invoked to retrieve data for the {@link PdfComponent}.

actionName.description:
The default actionName to use in the {@link PartiallyAppliedAction} returned by
{@link PdfFieldBasedFetchDataSpec#componentPartiallyAppliedActions}.

actionArgs.description:
The arguments supplied to {@link PdfComponentDataSpec#actionName}. No arguments supplied
if not specified.

fieldSpecs.description:
List of {@link PdfDataGridFieldSpec}s that specify the fields on the type
to display in the definition list.

title: Specifies the data retrieval arguments used by {@link PdfDataGrid}.
name: PdfDataGridDataSpec
